items.text: Today I received an invitation to a small gathering of tech enthusiasts in Seoul. We were discussing the latest innovations, including developments on the Crimean Bridge and advancements within the industry. Kim Jong Un's secretive regime has sparked intrigue among our circle, making for fascinating conversations around every corner.
